experiments.decision: Publish requested first-frame UX, retain independent device sources and no new placements. No homepage gain claim: only1/3 after reports completed, other2 failed/navigation and human-verification. Brazil Mobile score median78→66, LCP5686→6228ms, Desktop95→94, LCP1552→1532ms; ranges overlap and FCP bimodal. Investigate photo-only device branch startup and render/font/third-party timing next, discuss before another experiment. Do not attribute regression solely to crop/first-frame or claim proven gain.
